title: Fossil hunting for beginners: where to go, what to bring and what you can keep

posts.facebook:
No tools, no training, no permit on most beaches. Fossil hunting is a walk with a treasure hunt built in.

A beginner's guide to fossil hunting: why it is easier than it looks, the honest challenges, the rules on what you can keep, what to bring, and guided walks and free fossil parks in the UK and US.

Book one guided walk, learn what to look for, then go back to the same beach on a falling tide.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/explore/fossil-hunting-for-beginners/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
